words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.ex: He spends hours in cyberspace every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在虚拟空间里花几个小时。
words.en: Cyberspace is the notional environment in which communication over computer networks occurs.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: People are increasingly using smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 人们日益使用智能手机。
words.en: More and more; gradually becoming greater in amount or degree.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.ex: The soldiers defend their country from enemies.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们保卫自己的国家免受敌人入侵。
words.en: To defend means to protect someone or something from attack, harm, or criticism. It can also involve arguing in support of someone or something.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

chapters.name: Unit 12 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 更确切地说；倒不如说
words.ex: He is not lazy, or rather, he is efficient in his own way.
words.ex_cn: 他并不懒，或者更准确地说，他有自己的高效方式。
words.en: used to correct or modify what has just been said, or to say it more accurately

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 超出某人控制范围的；无法控制的
words.ex: The weather is beyond one's control.
words.ex_cn: 天气是无法控制的。
words.en: If something is beyond your control, you cannot change it or influence it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 引起对…的注意；使关注
words.ex: He raised his hand to call attention to the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手来指出这个错误。
words.en: To make someone notice something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 提醒某人注意……；使某人关注……
words.ex: The teacher called my attention to the mistake in my homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师指出了我作业中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's focus or awareness towards something.

words.tr: phrase. 《纽约时报》（美国著名日报）
words.ex: The New York Times is known for its in-depth reporting.
words.ex_cn: 《纽约时报》以其深入的报道而闻名。
words.en: A prominent American daily newspaper published in New York City.

words.tr: phrase. 杰里米·边沁（1748–1832，英国哲学家、法学家，功利主义伦理学创始人）
words.ex: Jeremy Bentham is best known for his advocacy of utilitarianism.
words.ex_cn: 杰里米·边沁以其对功利主义的倡导而最为人所知。
words.en: Jeremy Bentham was an English philosopher, jurist, and social reformer regarded as the founder of modern utilitarianism.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.ex: He tried to curb his horse with the reins.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用缰绳勒住马。
words.en: If you curb something, you control it and keep it within limits.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: His converse was the opposite of what he said earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他的相反言论与他之前说的话相反。
words.en: To engage in conversation; to talk informally with someone.

words.ex: He tried to detach himself from the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图脱离这个群体。
words.en: If you detach one thing from another that it is fixed to, you remove it. If one thing detaches from another, it becomes separated from it.

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The existence of life on other planets is still unknown.
words.ex_cn: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍不清楚。
words.en: The state or fact of existing; being.

words.tr: adv. 无论什么；任何(用于否定句中以加强语气)；
words.ex: You can eat whatever food whatsoever.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何食物。
words.en: used to emphasize a negative statement

words.ex: He uses Chrome as his browser.
words.ex_cn: 他用 Chrome 作为他的浏览器。
words.en: A browser is a piece of computer software that you use to search for information on the Internet.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

chapters.name: Unit 12 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: Many readers identify with the main character's struggles.
words.ex_cn: 许多读者对主角的挣扎感同身受。
words.en: If you identify with someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings and ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 被卷入；陷入（某种情况或情绪中）
words.ex: He was caught up in the excitement of the game.
words.ex_cn: v. 他被比赛的热情所吸引。
words.en: To become involved in something, often without intending to.

words.tr: phrase. v. 卷入；陷入（某种情况或活动）；被某事吸引而无法自拔
words.ex: He got caught up in the movie and forgot to eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他看得太入迷，忘了吃晚饭。
words.en: To become involved in something, often without intending to, so that it is difficult to escape or stop.

words.tr: phrase. 暂缓；搁置；暂停处理；使等待
words.ex: The project is put on hold until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目被暂停到下个月。
words.en: To postpone or delay something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…没有影响；与…无关
words.ex: What he wore has no bearing on whether he did the work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿什么与他是否做了工作毫无关系。
words.en: To have no bearing on something means to have no influence or relevance to it.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.tr: phrase. 《鹧鸪家庭》（美国1970年代著名电视情景喜剧及音乐组合）
words.ex: The Partridge Family was a popular show in the 1970s.
words.ex_cn: 《The Partridge Family》是20世纪70年代的一部受欢迎的电视剧。
words.en: An American musical comedy television series about a family band.

words.tr: 专有名词。《查理·布朗的大南瓜》，是《花生漫画》系列中的经典电视特辑，讲述查理·布朗的朋友莱纳斯坚信“大南瓜”会在万圣节出现并带来礼物的故事。
words.ex: Charlie Brown waits for the great pumpkin every Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 查理·布朗每个万圣节都等待伟大的南瓜。
words.en: A 1966 animated television special featuring the Peanuts characters.

words.tr: abbr. National Broadcasting Company <美>国家广播公司; Nuc
words.ex: He watches the news on NBC every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上在NBC上看新闻。
words.en: The National Broadcasting Company, a major American television network.

words.tr: n. 美国广播公司；“ American Broadcasting Corporation”的缩写；字母表；
words.ex: I watched the news on ABC last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚在美國廣播公司看了新聞。
words.en: The first letter of the English alphabet, used as a placeholder or example.

words.tr: abbr. Columbia Broadcasting System （美国）哥伦比亚广播公司
words.ex: He watches CBS every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看CBS。
words.en: The Columbia Broadcasting System, a major American television network.
